{{Short description|Estonian sport biologist}}

[[File:Kristjan Port, arvamusfestival 2014.jpg|thumb|Kristjan Port]]
'''Kristjan Port''' (born 9 May 1960 in [[Tallinn]]) is an [[Estonia]]n [[sports science|sport biologist]].<ref name="ETIS">{{cite web |title=CV: Kristjan Port |url=https://www.etis.ee/CV/Kristjan_Port/est?lang=ENG |website=www.etis.ee |access-date=22 March 2021}}</ref> 2008–2015, he was the head of [[Tallinn University]]'s Institute of Health Sciences and Sport Institute.<ref name="ETIS" /> Since 2008, he is a member of Estonian Anti-Doping Foundation.<ref name="ETIS" />

In 2020, he was awarded with [[Order of the White Star]], III class.<ref name="president.ee">{{cite web |title=Teenetemärkide kavalerid: Kristjan Port |url=https://www.president.ee/et/vabariik/teenetemargid/kavaler/19945/kristjan-port |website=www.president.ee |access-date=22 March 2021}}</ref>
